# raff_app_database_link (Resource)

Links a managed database to a Raff Apps service. The app gets its own database user and DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_HOST, DATABASE_PORT, DATABASE_USER, DATABASE_PASSWORD, DATABASE_NAME and DATABASE_CA_CERT, then redeploys. Deleting the link removes the user and the variables.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) ID of a running managed database (`raff_database.<name>.id`).
- `service_id` (String) ID of the app (`raff_app_service.<name>.id`).

### Optional

- `env_prefix` (String) Prefix of the variables (default `DATABASE`). Give a second database its own prefix.

### Read-Only

- `database_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `injected_keys` (List of String) The variables the link sets.
- `status` (String)
- `status_message` (String)
